$Comment: The pumpkin patch: while Hallow's Eve runs, a pumpkin harvested by hand sometimes comes with a
Hallowed Pumpkin, straight into the bag beside the harvest. The patch itself is the game's own
pumpkins, grown or found all year; only this find is seasonal. The file name is the row's id.
When names PickupItem, the moment a hand harvest lands, on the harvested stack's item id
Plant_Crop_Pumpkin_Item. Chance is the row's own odds as a percent (20 is one harvest in five).
The season rides on each roll's Conditions: calendar_live reads 1 only while the event runs. The
first roll is the find and carries the toast's Cue; the second adds one more on Harvest Moon
nights. A server owner retunes or switches off this row by its id in
